name: Structured noise (phase-preserving diffusion)
plain: Builds noise from a reference latent: keep Gaussian-like magnitude from noise but take the Fourier phase from the reference at low frequencies. The result carries the reference's composition. Three ways to draw the magnitude are offered.
math:
F_ref=fftshift(fft2(pad(z))), phase φ_r=angle(F_ref) then clipped; F_n from noise, or Rayleigh(√(N·σ²/2)) magnitudes with uniform phase (cdf) or √(u1²+u2²) (two-gaussian).
Mask M(r) = 1 for r≤cutoff, else exp(−(r−cutoff)²/(2·tw²)); no cutoff → all ones.
φ = M·φ_r + (1−M)·φ_n. out = Re ifft2(|F_n|·noise_std·exp(iφ)); pixels outside ±5 replaced by the raw noise; cropped.

props.spectrum: same magnitude as white on average; phase follows image
